namespaceOverride.description: Override the deployment namespace; defaults to .Release.Namespace

commonLabels.description: labels that'll be applied to all resources

deploymentAnnotations.description: Annotations that'll be applied to deployment

deschedulerPolicy.description: deschedulerPolicy contains the policies the descheduler will execute.

deschedulerPolicyAPIVersion.description: Recommended to use the latest Policy API version supported by the Descheduler app version

deschedulingInterval.description: Required when running as a Deployment

initContainers.description:
Init containers to run before the main descheduler container
Example:
- name: init-myservice
image: busybox:1.28
command: ['sh', '-c', 'echo The app is running! && sleep 10']

leaderElection.description:
Specifies whether Leader Election resources should be created
Required when running as a Deployment
NOTE: Leader election can't be activated if DryRun enabled
enabled: true
leaseDuration: 15s
renewDeadline: 10s
retryPeriod: 2s
resourceLock: "leases"
resourceName: "descheduler"
resourceNamespace: "kube-system"

namespaceOverride.description: Override the deployment namespace; defaults to .Release.Namespace

replicas.description:
Specifies the replica count for Deployment
Set leaderElection if you want to use more than 1 replica
Set affinity.podAntiAffinity rule if you want to schedule onto a node
only if that node is in the same zone as at least one already-running descheduler

additionalLabels.description:
The namespace where Prometheus expects to find service monitors.
namespace: ""
Add custom labels to the ServiceMonitor resource

suspend.description:
startingDeadlineSeconds: 200
successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
failedJobsHistoryLimit: 1
ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 600
activeDeadlineSeconds: 60 # Make sure this value is SHORTER than the cron interval.
timeZone: Etc/UTC

tolerations.description:
- maxSkew: 1
topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
labelSelector:
matchLabels:
app.kubernetes.io/name: descheduler
- key: 'management'
operator: 'Equal'
value: 'tool'
effect: 'NoSchedule'

topologySpreadConstraints.description:
nodeAffinity:
requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
nodeSelectorTerms:
- matchExpressions:
- key: kubernetes.io/e2e-az-name
operator: In
values:
- e2e-az1
- e2e-az2
podAntiAffinity:
requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
- labelSelector:
matchExpressions:
- key: app.kubernetes.io/name
operator: In
values:
- descheduler
topologyKey: "kubernetes.io/hostname"
